text.headline: A Garden Year
text.text: Twelve months in a small garden: what was planted, what came up, and what the weather did.

text.headline: First seeds in trays
text.text: Tomatoes, basil and a row of sweet peas on the windowsill.

text.headline: Beds dug and mulched
text.text: Two new raised beds, filled with last year’s leaf mould.

text.headline: First sweet pea in bloom
text.text: Pale pink, along the north fence.

text.headline: Tomato harvest
text.text: Seven weeks of tomatoes; the basil kept up.
